stem.text: The diagram illustrates the position of particles in a progressive sound wave at one instant in time.

stem.alt: Row of dots representing particles of a wave at one instant, with points P and Q labelled above two of the dots, and a double-headed arrow labelled L beneath them.

stem.text: The speed of the wave is $v$. P and Q are two points in the wave a distance $L$ apart.
What is an expression for the frequency of the wave?
